comment: The text states that TOGAF works from business goals through capabilities and application services “to the technical components.” However, the architecture deliberately limits its treatment of the technology layer and focuses primarily on application components.

anchor.note: p.24 l.Lines 18-26 read as the printed page; section 2 does NOT agree

public.text: The text states that TOGAF works from business goals through capabilities and application services “to the technical components.” However, the architecture deliberately limits its treatment of the technology layer and focuses primarily on application components.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace “technical components” with “application components and their supporting specifications,” or explicitly describe how far the architecture addresses the technology layer.
